summary.en: Enterprise-focused LLMs with strong retrieval and RAG capabilities.
summary.zh: 专注于企业的 LLM，具备强大的检索和 RAG 能力。

title.en: Cohere API Key - Enterprise LLMs with RAG | Get Model Key
title.zh: Cohere API Key - 具备 RAG 能力的企业级 LLM | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Cohere API key for enterprise LLMs. Access Command R, embedding models and RAG capabilities.
description.zh: 获取 Cohere API Key，访问企业级 LLM。使用 Command R、嵌入模型和 RAG 能力。

en: Cohere builds enterprise-oriented Command models plus Embed and Rerank, aimed at retrieval-augmented generation and production RAG stacks.
Teams choose Cohere when search quality, grounding, and enterprise deployment patterns matter as much as raw chat generation.
Cohere is an official model company, not a multi-vendor aggregator. Get Model Key only links to dashboard.cohere.com; we do not sell API keys.
zh: Cohere 面向企业提供 Command 系列，以及 Embed、Rerank，侧重检索增强生成（RAG）与生产级检索链路。
当检索质量、内容 grounding 与企业部署方式与对话生成同样重要时，团队常会选择 Cohere。
Cohere 是官方模型公司，不是多厂商聚合站。Get Model Key 仅跳转 dashboard.cohere.com，不售卖 API Key。

en: Open API Keys (dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys) and create a production or trial key as offered.
Store the key in your secret manager; rotate it if it is ever exposed.
Call Command, Embed, or Rerank endpoints with Authorization: Bearer <key> per docs.cohere.com.
zh: 打开 API Keys（dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys），按控制台选项创建正式或试用密钥。
将密钥存入密钥管理系统；一旦泄露应立即轮换。
按 docs.cohere.com，使用 Authorization: Bearer <key> 调用 Command、Embed 或 Rerank。

question.en: Is Cohere mainly for chat or for RAG?
question.zh: Cohere 更偏聊天还是 RAG？

answer.en: Cohere offers chat-capable Command models, but its enterprise positioning strongly emphasizes Embed, Rerank, and RAG workflows.
answer.zh: Cohere 提供可对话的 Command 模型，但其企业定位更强调 Embed、Rerank 与 RAG 工作流。

question.en: Where do I create a Cohere API key?
question.zh: 在哪里创建 Cohere API Key？

answer.en: Create and manage keys at https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys. API reference is at https://docs.cohere.com/.
answer.zh: 在 https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys 创建与管理密钥。接口说明见 https://docs.cohere.com/。

question.en: Does Get Model Key sell Cohere credits?
question.zh: Get Model Key 会售卖 Cohere 额度吗？

answer.en: No. This site only links to Cohere’s official dashboard. All purchases stay with Cohere.
answer.zh: 不会。本站只链接 Cohere 官方控制台，一切购买与计费均在 Cohere 完成。
